title: Admin Auth and Main-site Superadmin Sync Contract
principles: Never commit plaintext passwords or reusable default admin credentials.
Bootstrap superadmin only from environment variables or an interactive secret source.
Store password_hash only; force password rotation after first login when bootstrap_created=true.
Main-site superadmin sync uses scoped API key or signed internal API call, not shared plaintext password.
Every admin auth and sync action must write audit log records.

password_policy.hashing: scrypt sha256, per-user salt, constant-time verify
password_policy.rotation: bootstrap account must change password on first login

session_policy.type: httpOnly secure cookie or bearer session token

sync_policy.main_site_superadmin_identity: email must match configured ADMIN_SUPERUSER_EMAIL unless explicitly overridden
sync_policy.sync_mode: upsert remote admin identity and role mapping, never send plaintext password after initial bootstrap
